title: Preimage of a closed connected set under a quotient map with connected fibres
statement: Let $h:P\to W$ be a continuous map of topological spaces such that every fibre $h^{-1}(w)$, $w\in W$, is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] (in particular nonempty, so $h$ is surjective), and such that $W$ carries the quotient topology: a subset $T\subseteq W$ is closed if and only if $h^{-1}(T)$ is closed in $P$. Then for every closed connected subset $T\subseteq W$ the preimage $h^{-1}(T)$ is connected. In particular, if $W$ is connected, so is $P$.

source.place: Topology, Lemma 5.7.5 (Tag 0377, label lemma-connected-fibres-quotient-topology-connected-components, line 721): its proof shows that $f^{-1}(T)$ is connected for a connected component $T$; the argument uses only that $T$ is closed and connected
